```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

**Status: EXPLORATORY.** This starts a set of figures that treat the fava neighbor as a treatment, on
the same footing as AMF inoculation, and ask how fava suppresses the effect of AMF on wheat. This
first figure is the central allocation result (originally Figure 1 in `08.5_Research_Direction.Rmd`)
with the factors flipped: **panels = inoculation, lines = stand type (Inter vs Mono)**.

**Model.** Identical to the primary model: beta regression on `berry_alloc` with
`Poly * Inoc * Water` and dispersion varying by `Poly`, fitted **once** to all 60 pots. All contrasts
below are conditioned inside that model with `emmeans`; no subset models.

**Letters and p-values.** Within each inoculation panel there are six cells (stand type x water).
Letters come from a Tukey-adjusted compact letter display across those six cells (15 comparisons per
panel), so cells sharing a letter are not distinguishable *within that panel*. Letters are **not**
comparable between panels. The p-values on the figure are the Inter vs Mono contrast at each water
level, from the same Tukey family, so they are consistent with the letters. Tests are on the logit
scale; points and intervals are back-transformed to proportions.

```{r libs}
library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)
source("../fig_style.R")

wheat <- readRDS("../wheat_audited.rds")
stopifnot(nrow(wheat) == 60, all(table(wheat$Poly, wheat$Inoc, wheat$Water) == 5))

fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))
```

# Model

Water is given the same two planned orthogonal contrasts as the primary model. The fitted cell means
do not depend on this coding, but it keeps the model object identical to the one in Steps 3 and 8.5.

```{r model}
wheat_c <- wheat
contrasts(wheat_c$Water) <- cbind(severe = c(-0.5, -0.5, 1), mild = c(-1, 1, 0))

m1 <- glmmTMB(berry_alloc ~ Poly * Inoc * Water, dispformula = ~ Poly,
              family = beta_family(), data = wheat_c)
car::Anova(m1, type = 2)
```

# Estimated means, letters, and Inter vs Mono p-values

```{r emm}
emm <- emmeans(m1, ~ Poly * Water | Inoc)

# Tukey pairwise tests across the 6 Poly x Water cells within each Inoc panel (logit scale)
pw <- pairs(emm, by = "Inoc", adjust = "tukey") %>% as.data.frame()

# Letters from those same adjusted p-values, so letters and printed p-values agree
letters_for <- function(d) {
  pvec <- setNames(d$p.value, gsub(" ", "_", gsub(" - ", "-", d$contrast)))
  lt <- multcompView::multcompLetters(pvec, threshold = 0.05)$Letters
  tibble(cell = names(lt), .group = unname(lt))
}
lets <- pw %>% group_by(Inoc) %>% group_modify(~ letters_for(.x)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  separate(cell, into = c("Poly", "Water"), sep = "_")

cld_df <- as.data.frame(emm, type = "response") %>%
  left_join(lets, by = c("Inoc", "Poly", "Water")) %>%
  rename(prob = response)

# P-values: Inter vs Mono at each Water, same Tukey family
pv <- pw %>%
  separate(contrast, into = c("a", "b"), sep = " - ") %>%
  separate(a, into = c("Poly_a", "Water_a"), sep = " ") %>%
  separate(b, into = c("Poly_b", "Water_b"), sep = " ") %>%
  filter(Water_a == Water_b, Poly_a != Poly_b) %>%
  transmute(Inoc, Water = factor(Water_a, levels(wheat$Water)), p = p.value,
            lab = fmt_p(p.value))

cld_df$Water <- factor(cld_df$Water, levels(wheat$Water))
cld_df$Poly  <- factor(cld_df$Poly, c("Inter", "Mono"))

cld_df %>% arrange(Inoc, Water, Poly) %>%
  dplyr::select(Inoc, Water, Poly, prob, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL, letter = .group) %>%
  mutate(across(c(prob, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>% knitr::kable()
pv %>% arrange(Inoc, Water) %>% dplyr::select(Inoc, Water, `Tukey p (Inter vs Mono)` = p) %>%
  mutate(`Tukey p (Inter vs Mono)` = signif(`Tukey p (Inter vs Mono)`, 3)) %>% knitr::kable()
```

# Figure

Color = stand type (same palette as Figures 2-4); filled symbols and solid lines in the inoculated
panel, open symbols and dashed lines in the sterile panel.

```{r fig, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=6}
dodge <- position_dodge(0.35)
panel_lab <- c(Inoc = "Inoculated", Strl = "Sterile")

cld_df <- cld_df %>% mutate(InocL = factor(Inoc, names(panel_lab), panel_lab))
pv     <- pv %>% mutate(InocL = factor(Inoc, names(panel_lab), panel_lab))

fig_ft <- ggplot(cld_df, aes(Water, prob, color = Poly, group = Poly)) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = Inoc), position = dodge, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL), width = 0.15, position = dodge,
                linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Inoc), position = dodge, size = 3.4, stroke = 1.1, fill = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(y = asymp.UCL + 0.018, label = .group), position = dodge,
            size = 4, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = pv, aes(x = Water, y = 0.52, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 3.3, color = "grey25") +
  facet_wrap(~InocL) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal_poly, labels = poly_lab, breaks = c("Mono", "Inter")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shp_inoc, guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = lty_inoc, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.55), breaks = seq(0, 0.5, 0.1)) +
  labs(y = "Berry allocation (proportion of total NPP)", x = NULL,
       title = "Berry allocation by inter and PPT, within each inoculation treatment",
       subtitle = paste0("Estimated marginal means from the primary beta regression; bars = 95% CI.\n",
                         "Letters: Tukey CLD across the six cells within a panel. ",
                         "p-values: Inter vs Mono at each water level (Tukey)")) +
  theme_ms(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9.5, color = "grey30"))
fig_ft

ggsave("figures/Fig_FavaTreatment_BerryAlloc.pdf", fig_ft, width = 9.5, height = 6)
ggsave("figures/Fig_FavaTreatment_BerryAlloc.png", fig_ft, width = 9.5, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

**Reading it.** Inter (blue) vs Mono (orange) is now the comparison within each panel. In the sterile
panel the two stand types track each other; in the inoculated panel they separate at severe drought,
where inoculated monoculture collapses and inoculated intercrop does not. That is the fava-suppresses-
AMF-cost pattern from the original figure, seen with fava as the treatment.
